method.time_fractions: 129 uniform including endpoints, within common diagnostic support
method.endpoint_plane: span of normalized odd-source initial and final 9D vectors ONLY
method.plane_deviation: orthogonal 9D component relative to endpoint plane
method.affine_raw_chord: linear interpolation of raw unnormalized odd-source 9D endpoint vectors
method.spherical_geodesic_curvature: central finite difference, only interior nodes, normalized direction on S8
method.raw_euclidean_curvature: central finite difference; scaled time s=t/t_common
method.nested_grids: 16,32,64,128 intervals; report numerical convergence, not interval bounds
method.coordinate_change: SO9 time-dependent gauge undone before plane metrics
method.caution: Angular geodesicity and plane membership do not imply intrinsic material torsion or surface invariance
